gaps.detail: Inherited not-found report: CFT 13 states principalIdele_mem_range_ideleNormMap_iff for global units, whereas GQF 4.2/4.4 needs mem_range_ideleNormMap_iff for an arbitrary idele. gaps.title: The Hilbert character of an arbitrary idele needs a finite-support bridge
gaps.detail: GQF 4.4 defines the product of (i_v,b_v) for varying i. Combine the finite nonunit support of i, the fixed global coefficient support, dyadic places and archimedean places; then use the odd-residue unit-unit formula. A theorem for two global elements cannot directly be applied to an arbitrary idele.
